title: Three Terms and One Short Share
subtitle: 公平分享 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 公平分享（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·合作与分享）
meta: 主题语境：公平分享（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·合作与分享）　|　核心词汇：half　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 half 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the teacher ① divided a half that no pupil in the class would have described, and he said the dividing was the whole of the term. The ② half, meaning the share itself and not the whole, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a half, he said, is the only thing in a class that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ half in that class had the same short share beside it, and the ④ half at the far desk, meaning the portion they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A half, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the teacher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the half was the whole of the matter, meaning the break and not the share. The ⑥ half, meaning the break and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; half, he said, is either something you divide or the only word that means both a share and a break. He said the break is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ half had become a line in a note, and the note had become an argument about the short share. The ⑧ half of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in November, was one class and three terms of describing; half, he said, is either the portion at the far desk or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ half I remember is the half described in the note, which closed in 1977 and is still described as the quietest in the class. A ⑩ half, my mother said in 1979, is the only one that improves by being described; every half, she said, is a break that has agreed to look like a share. She said the break was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 一半（指班里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 一半（指那份份额本身，与整体相对）
C. 固定搭配：divide a half 分出一半
D. n. 半场（指留给孩子们看的那一节）
E. n. 半数（抽象总称，指一个班级的一半之事）
F. n. 一半（指便条里写到、被记下的那一份）
G. n. 中场休息；半场（指一件事里人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 中场（抽象总称，指人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: divided a half that no pupil in the class would have described
The half, meaning the share itself and not the whole
the half at the far desk
the half was the whole of the matter
the half had become a line in a note
The half of the whole thing
A half, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: divide a half 意为“分出一半”，1970 年那位老师分出了班里没有一位学生肯描述的一半。
half 意为“一半”，指那份份额本身而不是整体，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
half 意为“一半”，指班里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一份矮矮的配额。
half 意为“半场”，指最远那张课桌上留给孩子们看的那一节，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
half 意为“中场休息、半场”，指一件事里人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段中场就是那件事的全部。
half 意为“中场”，指人人都盼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那一半，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
half 意为“一半”，指便条里写到、被记下的那一份，到 1975 年这一份成了便条里的一行。
half 意为“半数”，老师十一月写道，整件事的一半之事是一个班级和三个学期的描述。
half 意为“一半”，我记得的是便条里描述过的那一份，1977 年分完了，至今仍被说成班里最安静的一份。
half 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，一半是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的份额。
